required.description: The protected control and evaluation surface is unchanged by the code under evaluation (integrity hashes checked before each gate)
Each evaluation starts from a fresh environment with no state left by an earlier one
The byte cap on feedback holds and records when it cuts text
The number of held-out queries a set has served stays below its cap
Budgets and the clock are not reset by a recovery
No network rule, credential, or sandbox is left behind after a run
